messages:
Sam: Hi team — quick logistics q: I'll be back onsite in 2 weeks and want to confirm lactation room booking etiquette + reimbursement for pump accessories. Can someone outline the steps?
Evelyn: Welcome back planning! :wave: TL;DR: recurring bookings are allowed, nursing parents get booking priority, and theres a one-time reimbursement for pumps/accessories. Details below.
Sam: Awesome, thanks. How do I actually reserve recurring slots (I need 25-35m twice daily)?
Facilities: Hey Sam — use the internal room scheduler (link below). Choose the building lactation suite, set a recurring event up to 8 weeks at a time, and include a short note like "Lactation - Sam". If you need longer than 8 weeks, ping people-ops and well extend based on usage. If another parent has an urgent need, Facilities will coordinate a swap and notify both parties.
Sam: Good to know. Is there any formal priority order? Eg. infant age or pumping frequency?
Evelyn: Priority order: 1) currently lactating/chestfeeding parents with infants under 6 months, 2) under 12 months, 3) those with documented medical need. We try to be flexible but thats the general triage.
Ravi: From a team perspective we can cover short standups. Sam, post your recurring blocks and Ill sketch a rotating coverage note so async tasks are covered.
Sam: Thank you! On reimbursement: can I expense a small battery pump and extra parts? What codes/proof needed?
Evelyn: Yes. Policy: one-time benefit for pump or supplies up to $250. How to file: Expenses > New Expense, attach receipt(s), set category to "Family Benefits" and use expense code PARENT-PUMP-2024. If you bought via subscription (rental), upload the invoice showing charge dates. Reimbursements processed within one payroll cycle after approval.
Sam: If I buy the pump while still on leave, will that delay approval/processing?
people-ops-bot: Ticket logged: HR-EXP-424. People Ops aims to process pump reimbursements within 10 business days of submission.
Evelyn: You can submit anytime. If you want faster handling, add a note "returning on <date>" and well prioritize. Facilities also has a small stock of loaner pumps for onsite use if you need something immediately; reserve through the portal and mark "loaner request".
Sam: Great — is there guidance on calendar visibility? I prefer to keep slot titles private.
Ravi: Practical tip: set event privacy to "private" and name it "PUMP" so coworkers see availability but not details. Also set Slack status to "In pumping break" for the duration to reduce notifications.
Sam: Perfect. One last: any forms or manager approvals needed?
Evelyn: No formal sign-off required for room booking or reimbursement. Managers should be informed for coverage planning. If you need accommodations beyond the standard policy (longer than 6 months, disability-related schedule), submit a quick accommodation request to People Ops and well loop in Health & Safety.
Facilities: Quick link: https://intranet.redwood.com/facilities/lactation-suites (use office SSO). Step snippet:
```
- Open scheduler -> select "Lactation Suite B"
- Click Recurring -> choose days/time (max 8w) -> add note "Lactation - <name>"
- For loaner pump: toggle "Loaner Request"
```
Sam: Thank you all — booking recurring 9:45am and 2:30pm M/T/Th for first 6 weeks, will post cal invites now. Appreciate the help :heart:
